title: Article
description: Shape of a published article document persisted to Firestore `articles/{date}` (the document key is `date`). Written server-side by the Minion `publish` step via `model_dump(mode="json")`; read by the PWA reading surface (F-009). Field names are snake_case to match the persisted document. Source of truth for the Minion publish model and the PWA article repository.

date.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Paris). Firestore document key and idempotency key.

slug.description: URL slug derived from the article title.

theme.description: The article's tech-watch theme; rendered as a TagPill in the PWA.

body.description: Article body (Markdown), rendered with the prose-veilleur tokens.

linkedin.description: Ready-to-post LinkedIn text (≤3000 chars). Consumed by the PWA share sheet (F-010).

image.description: Hero image filename, e.g. "2026-06-01.webp" (mirrors frontmatter.image). Resolved by the PWA against the public Astro images base URL.

commit_sha.description: GitHub commit SHA set by the `publish` step once the article lands on the Astro site; null before the commit.

published.description: False = recoverable pre-commit persist; true = live on the public site.

Frontmatter.title: Frontmatter
Frontmatter.description: Astro content-collection frontmatter for the generated article.

image.description: Hero image filename; empty at generation time, filled by the Imagen step.
